mathematical_meanings: Left image: O names the center of the circle. Right image: O names the center of the circle.
Rationales: The left occurrence is located at O beside the interior point above the horizontal chord; the right occurrence is at O beside the interior point joined to points on the circle. Both use the selected notation for the same circle-center naming function. This compares the local role, without asserting that the two underlying objects or unknown values are identical.
